import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize sex label variants (FEMALE -> female); keep missing as NaN
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].apply(lambda v: v.strip().lower() if isinstance(v, str) else v)
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors): -185 -> 185, -212 -> 212
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (extra zeros, e.g. 5700000 -> 5700)
    bm = df['body_mass_g'].astype(float)
    df['body_mass_g'] = bm.apply(lambda v: v / 1000.0 if pd.notna(v) and v > 6500 else v)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    g = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
